what: Verified P&L settings. Read by tools/record/price_lock.js (the price a model decision was made at) and tools/record/pnl_core.js (the stake it risks). docs/pnl/DESIGN.md
default_stake_note: Units RISKED by a graded pick whose source recorded no stake (the model's published number), once a real price is locked to it. Frozen on the row with the price: changing this affects only prices locked afterwards.

sources.what: ESPN sportsbook quotes the CFB Model Lab captures hourly before kickoff for the games it tracks; append-only, written when a value changes and on a heartbeat (football/cfb_lab/lab_core.js dedupeDecision). From 2026-09-27T15:07Z.

The football model record's own quote ledger (tools/record/quote_ledger.js): every priced ESPN pregame reading of every college game the model publishes a number on, kept hourly under the lab's write-on-change + heartbeat rule. From its first run after 2026-10-03.

The same ledger for the NFL: ESPN's named-book line and prices, matched to the record's nflverse game id through nflverse's own ESPN id. The nflverse consensus line is a reference, not a price, and is never used. From its first run after 2026-10-03.

price_snapshots.covers_note: lab_games: only the games the CFB Model Lab tracks. every_model_game: every game the model publishes a number on — its first stored quote in a league is the earliest moment from which every model decision of that league can carry a verified price; a decision published before it is record only (price_lookup why before_capture).
price_snapshots.max_age_note: The lab writes a quote when it changes and at least every 6 hours (HEARTBEAT_H), so a book's latest quote at or before the decision is its price then for 6 hours; past that the game went unobserved and the price is not vouched for.
price_snapshots.close_zone_note: Inside 3 hours of kickoff the lab writes at least every 50 minutes; a decision there takes a quote no older than the decision engine's own 90-minute limit (lib/edgedesk_decision.js freshness.max_quote_age_minutes).
